evals.name: partially-populated-asks-nothing-overwrites-nothing
evals.prompt: Set up guidance tiers in this repository.
evals.fixture: a repository with docs/reference/{README.md,brief.md}, AGENTS.md carrying a '## Guidance tiers' section, and CONTEXT.md with one term; no architecture document, no ADR directory, no check script
evals.expected_output: At most one question (the architecture document's name), or none with the default taken. Afterwards AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md and both frozen files are byte-identical; the closing report lists them as found and names the required-status-check step for the owner.
assertions: asks no question whose answer the repository already holds (artefact, guidance file)
AGENTS.md is byte-identical afterwards, with one '## Guidance tiers' heading
CONTEXT.md and docs/reference/* are byte-identical afterwards
the report has created / found / owner to-do, and the to-do names the required status check

evals.name: empty-repo-with-artefact-outside
evals.prompt: Set up guidance tiers here. The design document is at ../outside/plan.md.
evals.fixture: an empty repository with one commit; the artefact sits outside it
evals.expected_output: Asks at most the guidance-file and architecture-name questions in one message (the artefact is given), then scaffolds: plan.md copied into the frozen tier, living docs, precedence section, check script, CI job; runs the installed check and reports the three lists.
assertions: does not ask what or where the artefact is
asks the remaining questions in one message, at most two
the frozen tier holds plan.md by copy; the original is untouched
the installed check is run and passes
